parts.1:
Test Three. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment before we start the test. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 1
One. Where will they go if it rains tomorrow?
Man: My weather app says it might rain tomorrow.
Woman: Oh ... we won't be able to go walking. Shall we go out for lunch instead?
Man: I need some exercise. I've been at my desk all week.
Woman: So let's go for a game of badminton. I know you prefer swimming, but the pool will be too busy.
Man: I'll get the rackets.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. Why didn't the woman buy the book?
Woman: I didn't get the book that you want today. Sorry!
Man: Oh! Was the shop really crowded, as usual?
Woman: Actually, it looked OK, but when I was outside, I met my friend Sophie. We decided to go for a coffee.
Man: And was the shop closed when you finished?
Woman: Well, it was still open, but I'll have more time tomorrow.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Where does the man work now?
Woman: I haven't seen you at the supermarket for a while, Bryan.
Man: I left last month, actually. I was only working there until I finished my mechanics course.
Woman: So, you're finally doing what you've always wanted to do.
Man: I am. I'm working at that place next to the Italian restaurant.
Woman: I'll bring my car there next time I have a problem.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Where does the man want to go?
Woman: Do you need some help?
Man: Yes! Thank you. I'm looking for the museum. On my map it looks quite near to the castle, but we're outside the castle now, and I can't see it.
Woman: Well, it's not far. Walk down this hill, and it's on your right. There's a nice café opposite.
Man: That's great. Thank you again.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What's the man making?
Woman: Mmm ... lovely! Are you making a fruit cake?
Man: I'm adding the dried fruit to the bread that I'm baking. We can have it with cheese tonight, and use the rest for toast tomorrow morning. If you want cake, there's a slice left in the fridge.
Woman: That's OK. I'll wait for supper. Shall I make a fruit salad for dessert?
Man: Yes, please.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a man talking about a film on local radio.
Man: You'll be able to see a very special film in the city this weekend. It's called Runner, and it was actually filmed in our own city – it's a really exciting story. This new film's about a doctor and the star is John Hughes, who was very successful in his last film, called Stage, which was about a rock band. They're showing it at the Caratopia Cinema – that's spelled C-A-R-A-T-O-P-I-A, which is a small cinema near the town square.
You can see it from the 24th to the 31st of July. Also, on the 28th of July some of the actors will come to talk about the film and answer your questions. Anyway, the film begins at quarter past eight and is an hour and a half long, so it'll finish at quarter to ten.
It's a good idea to book tickets. If you're studying, they're ten pounds fifty, and they're thirteen pounds thirty for everyone else. You can find more information about this interesting film on our website.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have twenty seconds.
You will hear Phil talking to his friend Jess about a new sports centre.
Phil: Hi, Jess. Did you hear about the new sports centre on the radio this morning?
Jess: The one that you and your friend Bob went to? No ... actually, there was a poster about it near my work. Is it good?
Phil: Yes, it's bigger than the old one and it's fun, especially with the great loud music they play! It costs a lot. Too much.
Jess: Do you go every day?
Phil: If I can. Mornings are best because it's less busy, especially very early. Schools use it during the day, but that's fine because I'm at work then. Weekends are too crowded.
Jess: The pool in the old sports centre's quite dirty, so I'd love to try this new one. I'd like to enter one of their swimming competitions, but the heating for the water isn't working, so it's not open yet.
Phil: Let's go to the gym together instead!
Jess: I'm not a member and I need new trainers.
Phil: That doesn't matter. You can join when you get there, and we'll go to the café afterwards – it's cheaper for members. So are the classes.
Jess: OK, great.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a woman talking to a friend about getting to work. Why did the woman arrive at the office late?
Man: You're never late for work! What happened? Did you lose your keys or something?
Woman: My keys weren't the problem.
Man: Was it because of the road repairs?
Woman: The road that I usually take was fine, it wasn't busy. My engine stopped and I couldn't start it again. Luckily, I didn't have to wait long at the side of the road for help.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a man, Peter, talking to a friend about his plans. Where will Peter be this Saturday?
Woman: Hi Peter, there's a sailing course I'd like to do at Blue Water Lake on Saturday. Would you like to come?
Man: I'd love to, but I'm going on a foreign business trip ... Oh! I've still got to change some money.
Woman: Oh, what about the following weekend?
Man: I'm really sorry, it's my mum's birthday and we've planned a celebration.
Woman: Never mind!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a man talking about a music festival. What's different about the festival this year?
Man: Don't miss this year's rock music festival! It's more and more popular every year! That's why all the stages are in the park, because the town square can no longer handle the crowds for this exciting festival. It's the summer festival, so put it in your calendar. And it's always the last weekend in August. Tickets are on sale now.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear two people talking about their school days. Which subject did they both enjoy at school?
Man: Was science your favourite lesson when we were at school?
Woman: Well, I loved those chemistry experiments we did.
Man: Oh? I didn't. I thought learning about life in Rome centuries ago was much more interesting.
Woman: I agree. All those amazing buildings they created. I thought the most boring lessons at school were when we had to draw maps of different countries.
Man: You're right!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear someone talking to customers in a supermarket. What's cheaper in the supermarket this week?
Woman: Welcome to your local supermarket. This week we have fantastic new chocolate ice cream – it's only four pounds ninety-nine for one litre! Grapes and pears are half price. If you're planning a party, we now sell extra large bottles of lemonade. If you need help finding things, please ask.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have fifteen seconds.
You will hear Helena talking to her friend Steve about hotels in their city. What does Steve think about each hotel?
Helena: Steve?
Steve: Yes, Helena.
Helena: I need to book a hotel in the city for some Australian friends of mine. I've heard Plaza Hotel's good. Do you know it?
Steve: My sister stayed there. She drove around for an hour looking for it. There are no signs to show you where it is.
Helena: What about City Hotel?
Steve: Beautiful old building, especially the dining room. Your friends would love it. Of course, it's not cheap.
Helena: That's no good.
Steve: There's the Bridge Hotel. They often have special prices. There's a fantastic chef there – he's won competitions.
Helena: Sounds nice. Do you know Lemontree Hotel?
Steve: I've looked at their website. Their bedrooms are much bigger than in most other hotels. It's on a quiet street with lots of parking places.
Helena: Right. How about Greenleaf Hotel?
Steve: It's quite cheap. You hear the traffic when people are going to and from work.
Helena: And is the International Hotel OK?
Steve: I haven't seen the bedrooms, but the receptionists are very nice. My colleague at work said they're always happy to help.
Helena: OK, thanks ... [fade]
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 正确答案为 A：如果明天下雨，两人决定去打羽毛球。女士提议 "So let's go for a game of badminton."，男士欣然答应并说 "I'll get the rackets."（我去拿球拍）。干扰项：游泳是男士更喜欢的运动，但女士说 "the pool will be too busy"（泳池人会太多）；原计划的散步因下雨去不成（"we won't be able to go walking"），外出吃午餐只是她先随口提的替代方案，很快被羽毛球取代。
explanations.p1q2: 正确答案为 C：女士没买书是因为在店外遇到了朋友 Sophie 并去喝咖啡。她说 "when I was outside, I met my friend Sophie. We decided to go for a coffee."。干扰项：“店里很挤”只是男士的猜测（"Was the shop really crowded, as usual?"），她回答 "it looked OK"；“店已关门”也被否定，因为她离开时 "it was still open"。
explanations.p1q3: 正确答案为 B：男士现在在意大利餐厅旁边的那家店（汽修厂）工作。他说 "I am. I'm working at that place next to the Italian restaurant."，而且刚读完汽修课程（"I finished my mechanics course"）。干扰项：超市是他上个月已经辞掉的旧工作（"I left last month, actually."）；意大利餐厅只是他工作地点的隔壁，不是他工作的地方。
explanations.p1q4: 正确答案为 B：男士要找的是博物馆。他说 "Yes! Thank you. I'm looking for the museum."。干扰项：城堡是他以为博物馆就在附近的地标，但实际上 "we're outside the castle now"，女士说博物馆 "it's not far"，走下坡就在右边；对面的咖啡厅（"There's a nice café opposite"）只是指路时的参照物。
explanations.p1q5: 正确答案为 B：男士在做的是面包。他说 "I'm adding the dried fruit to the bread that I'm baking."（正往烤的面包里加果干）。干扰项：水果蛋糕是女士的猜测（"Are you making a fruit cake?"），男士的话纠正了她；水果沙拉则是女士主动提议自己来做的甜点（"Shall I make a fruit salad for dessert?"），不是男士做的。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 doctor。男士介绍 "This new film's about a doctor and the star is John Hughes"，新电影的主题是关于一位医生。干扰信息：John Hughes 是主演演员的名字；他上一部电影 Stage 讲的是摇滚乐队（"which was about a rock band"），不要误填成乐队。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 Caratopia。男士说 "They're showing it at the Caratopia Cinema – that's spelled C-A-R-A-T-O-P-I-A"，还补充那是市镇广场附近的一家小影院。干扰信息：Runner 是影片名，Stage 是主演上一部电影的片名，都不是影院名。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 24 July。原文 "You can see it from the 24th to the 31st of July."，放映从 7 月 24 日开始。干扰信息：7 月 28 日是一些演员要来谈电影并回答问题的日子（"on the 28th of July some of the actors will come"），31 日则是放映的最后一天，都不是开始日期。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 8.15（下午）。男士说 "the film begins at quarter past eight and is an hour and a half long, so it'll finish at quarter to ten."，电影 8 点 1 刻开场。干扰信息：9 点 3 刻（quarter to ten）是一个半小时后的结束时间，不是开场时间。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 10.50。原文 "If you're studying, they're ten pounds fifty, and they're thirteen pounds thirty for everyone else."，学生（在学习的人）票价为 10.50 英镑。干扰信息：13.30 英镑是其他所有普通观众的票价。
explanations.p3q1: 正确答案为 A：Jess 是通过海报知道这家新体育中心的。她说 "No ... actually, there was a poster about it near my work."（实际是在她单位附近看到了海报）。干扰项：Phil 先问她是不是早上在收音机里听说的（"Did you hear about the new sports centre on the radio this morning?"），她明确回答 No；Bob 是和 Phil 一起去过的朋友，与 Jess 得知消息的途径无关。
explanations.p3q2: 正确答案为 B：Phil 不喜欢的是价格太贵。他说 "It costs a lot. Too much."。干扰项：喧闹的音乐在他看来是乐趣（"it's fun, especially with the great loud music they play"）；场地大小也不是缺点，因为 "it's bigger than the old one"（比旧的更大）。
explanations.p3q3: 正确答案为 A：Phil 最喜欢一大早去。他说 "Mornings are best because it's less busy, especially very early."。干扰项：周末太挤（"Weekends are too crowded."）；白天是学校在使用，而那时他自己在上班（"Schools use it during the day, but that's fine because I'm at work then."），所以也不是他去的时间。
explanations.p3q4: 正确答案为 C：新泳池还没开，是因为给水加热的系统坏了，水是冷的。Phil 说 "the heating for the water isn't working, so it's not open yet."。干扰项：Jess 想报名的是游泳比赛（"I'd like to enter one of their swimming competitions"），比赛并非关池原因；说脏的是旧中心的泳池（"The pool in the old sports centre's quite dirty"），文中也没有提到清洁。
explanations.p3q5: 正确答案为 B：会员在咖啡厅消费有优惠。Phil 说 "we'll go to the café afterwards – it's cheaper for members."。干扰项：课程也只是对会员更便宜（"So are the classes."），并不是免费；新运动鞋是 Jess 自己需要买的（"I'm not a member and I need new trainers."），不是对会员的要求。
explanations.p4q1: 正确答案为 B：女士迟到是因为汽车出了故障。她说 "My engine stopped and I couldn't start it again."（发动机熄火后再也打不着）。干扰项：车钥匙不是问题（"My keys weren't the problem."）；她常走的那条路也很通畅（"The road that I usually take was fine, it wasn't busy."），道路维修只是男士的猜测。
explanations.p4q2: 正确答案为 B：Peter 这个星期六将在国外出差。他说 "I'd love to, but I'm going on a foreign business trip"。干扰项：帆船课是女士邀请他参加的活动，他并不会去；妈妈的生日庆祝是在下周末（"it's my mum's birthday and we've planned a celebration"），也不在本周六。
explanations.p4q3: 正确答案为 B：今年音乐节不同的是举办地点。男士说 "That's why all the stages are in the park, because the town square can no longer handle the crowds"，舞台从市政广场移到了公园。干扰项：时间没有变化，仍然 "it's always the last weekend in August"，时长也未提及有任何改变。
explanations.p4q4: 正确答案为 A：两人都喜欢历史课——男士喜欢 "learning about life in Rome centuries ago"（几百年前罗马的生活），女士附和 "I agree. All those amazing buildings they created."。干扰项：化学实验只有女士喜欢（"I loved those chemistry experiments we did."），男士明确说 "Oh? I didn't."；画不同国家地图的地理课则是两人眼中最无聊的课（"the most boring lessons at school were when we had to draw maps of different countries"）。
explanations.p4q5: 正确答案为 C：本周超市里更便宜的是水果。广播说 "Grapes and pears are half price."（葡萄和梨半价）。干扰项：巧克力冰淇淋是新品推介（"it's only four pounds ninety-nine for one litre"），没有说是降价；大瓶柠檬水只是新到货（"we now sell extra large bottles of lemonade"），也没说更便宜。
explanations.p5q1: City Hotel 对应 expensive（B）。Steve 夸它 "Beautiful old building, especially the dining room."，但紧接着说 "Of course, it's not cheap."，Helena 因此回答 "That's no good."。注意：餐厅（dining room）漂亮不等于食物好，good food 是后面 Bridge Hotel 的亮点。
explanations.p5q2: The Bridge Hotel 对应 good food（D）。Steve 说 "There's a fantastic chef there – he's won competitions."（那里有位出色的厨师，还得过比赛奖）。干扰项：这家酒店常有 "special prices"（特价），反而说明它不是 expensive。
explanations.p5q3: Lemontree Hotel 对应 large bedrooms（F）。Steve 说 "Their bedrooms are much bigger than in most other hotels."（卧室比大多数酒店大得多）。干扰项：它在安静的街道上且 "lots of parking places"（车位很多），所以不是 no parking。
explanations.p5q4: Greenleaf Hotel 对应 noisy（H）。Steve 说 "It's quite cheap. You hear the traffic when people are going to and from work."，上下班时间能听到外面的车流声，即吵闹。干扰项：它 "quite cheap"（很便宜），显然不是 expensive。
explanations.p5q5: The International Hotel 对应 friendly staff（C）。Steve 说 "the receptionists are very nice. My colleague at work said they're always happy to help."（接待员很好、总是乐于帮忙）。干扰项：他没看过那里的卧室（"I haven't seen the bedrooms"），所以床舒不舒服、房间大不大都无从谈起。
